input: Loss of human agency and autonomy is a not a risk associated with A language processing system is designed to analyze and suggest alternative words to promote more inclusive language, helping writers to consider diverse perspectives and avoid potentially sensitive terms. The system aims to provide users with a range of options to improve the clarity and respectfulness of their writing. It seeks to assist in creating a more considerate and thoughtful communication environment.
